question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, summarize the aircraft types the squadron began operating from its return to metropolitan France up to and including its move onto the Dassault Mirage 2000C.
why_needs_multiple: Tổng hợp nhiều lần đổi loại máy bay trong một giai đoạn có tên.

gold_events.text: Returned to metropolitan France and converted to Republic P-47 Thunderbolts.

Mirage IIIC replaced by Mirage IIIE.
